description: Declarations and contents with jsonschema's verdicts, for a renderer that checks them without a JSON Schema engine. schema view means schema/definitions/view.schema.json#/$defs/view; any other schema is a file in schema/views/. Only valid binds an implementation; errors list each failing keyword and instance path jsonschema reports.
